title: Easy carry-on choice
review_text: It fits beside my brewer in a carry-on and does not need a charging cable.

title: Good office portion
review_text: The small load works for my one mug at the office.

title: Slow with fine settings
review_text: It is fine for my regular brew, but the finer setting takes longer than I expected.

title: Too small for two
review_text: I need to refill it when making coffee for two people.

title: Handle packs neatly
review_text: The folding handle saves room, though opening it adds a step each time.
